subject: MAP: Integration playbook / SDK auth / streaming — technical handoff & eval plan
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Integrations Team <integrations@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T15:12:00Z
Subject: MAP: SDK/Auth/Streaming — eval & proposed close timeline

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to lock down a mutual action plan (MAP) that covers SDK integration, authentication, streaming behavior (low-latency vs batched), and tool-calling support. Our procurement team needs an evaluation plan and an expected close window so we can align internal devs.

High level asks from Acme:
- A technical owner from Redwood for SDK + auth integration (we have two devs ready for pairing)
- An evaluation checklist we can run against our test harness (we can share results)
- Suggested canary/cutover dates and a proposed close timeline (target: mid-November)

Can you propose a weekly checkpoint cadence and owners? I attached a short list of our integration requirements for your intake.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Director, Integrations | Acme Corp

Attachment: integration_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub: API endpoints, expected auth flows, sample payloads)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: SDK/Auth/Streaming — eval & proposed close timeline

Thanks Olivia — appreciate the clear asks and the attachment.

Proposal from Redwood:
- Weekly 30-min technical checkpoints (Tuesdays 09:00 PT) for the next 6 weeks to track MAP milestones and unblock engineering work.
- Owners: Nikhil (commercial/rollout + MAP owner), Karthik (tech lead — SDK & auth), Monica (CS/QA coordinator).
- Eval plan: we will provide a short checklist + a runnable smoke suite you can run against your infra; aim for 2-week rolling cycles for deeper perf checks.
- Proposed timeline:
  * Discovery & handoff: this week (Sept 11–17)
  * SDK integration & auth pairing: Sept 20–Oct 8 (dev pairing + dry run)
  * Streaming & tool-calling tests (canary): Oct 11–25
  * Eval sign-off & procurement paperwork: Nov 1–12
  * Target close: Nov 15 (flex +/- 1 week)

I've attached a short intake doc (see your attachment) and will share a drive link with the MAP playbook and the eval checklist in the follow-up.

Next steps for us: Karthik to confirm technical owners and initial estimates; Monica to publish the first weekly checkpoint invite.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: SDK/Auth/Streaming — technical owners & task estimates

Quick technical readout from our pairing session outlook:

Summary of tasks, owners and first-pass estimates (effort = engineering days):
1) SDK integration (Node + Python): owner = Karthik Iyer; effort = 6 days (pairing + sample app)
2) Auth flow (OAuth + API key rotation): owner = Karthik Iyer; effort = 3 days (pairing + token lifecycle docs)
3) Streaming behavior tests (low-latency mode & batching scenarios): owner = Monica Patel; effort = 5 days (test harness + perf baselines)
4) Tool calling / structured outputs (function-calling surface): owner = Monica Patel; effort = 4 days (contract tests + sample tools)
5) Eval harness integration (Acme test runner -> Redwood eval suite): owner = Nikhil Sharma (coordination) + Acme devs; effort = 3 days for initial run

Blocking questions for Acme:
- Which SDK language should we prioritize for the first pairing session?
- Are there network restrictions (eg. egress IP allowlist) we should plan for?

Action items I propose to seed the MAP:
- K1: Confirm language for first SDK pairing (Acme) — due Sept 15
- M1: Share current test harness access and credentials (Acme) — due Sept 15
- N1: Publish weekly invite and MAP playbook link (Nikhil) — due Sept 12 (in progress)

I'll prepare short PRs with example snippets and a GitHub branch for the sample app.

–Karthik
Tech Lead, Inference Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:00:00Z
Subject: Meeting notes: 2026-09-15 MAP kickoff + action register

Notes from today's 30-min kickoff (attendees: Olivia, Acme devs, Nikhil, Karthik, Monica):

Decisions / agreements:
- Weekly tech sync agreed: Tuesdays 09:00 PT, recurring for 6 weeks. First live pairing session: Sept 21 (Node SDK).
- Acme will open a test project and provide credentials to the eval suite by Sept 17.
- Redwood will deliver a baseline eval checklist and a smoke runner by Sept 20.

Action register (owner — due):
- A1: Acme to confirm SDK language (Node) and provide test project invite — Olivia / Acme devs — due 2026-09-17
- A2: Redwood to publish MAP playbook (drive link) and invite — Nikhil — done (link below)
- A3: Karthik to draft SDK pairing plan + sample app branch — Karthik — due 2026-09-20
- A4: Monica to prepare streaming perf scenarios and test matrix — Monica — due 2026-09-25
- A5: Both teams to schedule a canary window Oct 11–15 — owners: Olivia + Nikhil — target scheduling by 2026-10-01

References:
- MAP playbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cMAP-playbook
- Eval checklist (draft): https://drive.google.com/open?id=eval-checklist-ACME

Please reply with any corrections; otherwise we'll treat this as the single source of truth for the agreed MAP items.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme.com>

Date: 2026-09-18T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Meeting notes: 2026-09-15 MAP kickoff + action register

Thanks team — everything looks good from our side. Confirming the Node SDK as the first pairing target.

We attached our eval harness (lightweight JSON manifest) and a short note on our internal test SLA (target: 99% pass on smoke tests for canary). We'll share credentials to the test project by EOD Sept 17 as agreed.

Canary preference: Oct 12–14 (we prefer mid-week).

Looking forward to the Sept 21 pairing — Olivia will join with two Acme devs.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
